items.name: Front wiper set 22"+17" (Bosch Advantage BA2217)
items.notes: Fits Saga MC2 (3rd gen, 2016-2025): driver 22", passenger 17", U-hook arm. Not for the all-new Saga MC3 launched Nov 2025.
items.summary: Genuine Bosch Advantage pair in the exact 22"/17" U-hook size for the Saga MC2, RM21.90 from an 8-year-old parts shop with 9.7k ratings. Step up to Bosch Clear Advantage (RM43.15, Bosch official) if you want a quieter flat blade.
pros: Exact Saga MC2 size and arm type
Cheapest listing that passes the quality floor
cons: Conventional frame blade, not a flat blade
Natural rubber wears faster than silicone in hot weather
Not a Mall store (Mall copy is RM2.10 more)

listings.notes: Bosch Advantage BA2217, 1 pair 22"+17", U-hook. Shop 8 years old, 92% response, 16 one-star reviews. Not a Mall store, so check the Bosch box and part number on arrival.
Step-up: Bosch Clear Advantage flat blade set 22"/17" for Saga BLM/FL/FLX/VVT, U-hook. List price RM67.00. Even pressure along the blade, quieter at highway speed.
Same Bosch Advantage 22"+17" from a Mall shop (7 years, 100% response) for RM2.10 more. Description also mentions 22"+16" for other models, so confirm the 22/17 set when ordering.
Bosch Advantage 22"/17" for Saga VVT from Bosch's own store. List price RM47.00. Pay RM8.37 more than the pick for buying direct from Bosch.

listings.voucher: Price is after shop voucher; Kamatto's own site shows RM79.90
listings.notes: Hydrophobic silicone wiper made for Saga VVT 2016-present. Silicone lasts longer in Malaysian heat, but this is a local brand and the water-repellent claims are the maker's own.
Bosch Aerotwin Retrofit 22"/17" for Saga VVT 2016-present. Bosch's top flat blade, but over 2x the Clear Advantage price for a small real-world gain.

Sold as 'Original HKS silicone, Made in Japan' with 1-year warranty. Fails: genuine HKS Super Wiper costs far more than RM17 a blade, and the shop is only 27 months old with 84% response, so it can't be verified as genuine.
'Supreme' silicone wiper 17"+22". Fails: shop response rate only 40%, and the brand can't be checked.
